decisions.headline: 《守墓人2》更新1.011改善平衡，但引导与部分系统仍显生涩
decisions.summary: Lazy Bear Games于10月30日发布《守墓人2》1.011更新，调整平衡并改善发售初期体验。AUTOMATON在实际游玩观察中指出，任务引导不足及僵尸数量软上限相关的PR系统仍会带来困惑与压力，更新后的体验仍有继续打磨空间。
decisions.verification: 固定packet保留AUTOMATON完整正文，明确给出开发商、1.011版本与10月30日发布时间；体验判断按媒体观察表述，不冒充开发者公告。
decisions.reason: 版本更新与仍存问题对现有玩家具有直接参考价值，且主体、窗口与核心事实清楚。
decisions.timeNote: 更新1.011于2026-10-30发布；报道发表于固定窗口内。

decisions.titleKey: カオス スマッシュ
decisions.headline: 免费浏览器射击游戏《カオス★スマッシュ》正式上线
decisions.summary: Moon Rabbit于10月29日启动免费浏览器游戏《カオス★スマッシュ》正式服务。游戏采用回合制射击与可破坏地形，无需下载，可通过Chrome或Edge游玩；首个联动活动计划11月12日开始，合作对象尚待公布。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON固定正文明确引用运营团队说明，并给出正式服务日期、浏览器形态、免费模式及11月12日联动计划；未猜测未公布的联动对象。
decisions.reason: 正式上线、游玩入口和首个活动日期均为清晰可执行的玩家信息。
decisions.timeNote: 正式服务于2026-10-29开始；首个联动活动计划2026-11-12启动。

entries.headline: Graveyard Keeper 2 update 1.011 improves balance, but guidance and some systems still feel rough
entries.summary: Lazy Bear Games released Graveyard Keeper 2 update 1.011 on October 30 with balance changes and improvements to the launch experience. AUTOMATON's hands-on assessment says unclear guidance and the PR system tied to the zombie soft cap still create friction.
entries.verification: The pinned AUTOMATON article clearly identifies the developer, version 1.011 and the October 30 date. Experience judgments are attributed to the publication, not presented as developer claims.
entries.timeNote: Update 1.011 released October 30, 2026; the article was published inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Free-to-play browser shooter カオス★スマッシュ launches in Japan
entries.summary: Moon Rabbit launched the free-to-play browser game カオス★スマッシュ on October 29. The turn-based shooter uses destructible terrain, requires no download and runs in Chrome or Edge. Its first collaboration event is planned for November 12, with the partner still unannounced.
entries.verification: The pinned AUTOMATON article quotes the operations team and states the service date, browser format, free-to-play model and November 12 collaboration plan. The unrevealed partner is not inferred.
entries.timeNote: Service launched October 29, 2026; the first collaboration event is planned for November 12.
